name: IPFS Desktop
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow primary updater behavior: IPFS Desktop disables background download, downloads after an update-available event, and installs on quit; release verification is delegated to electron-updater with release code-signing configuration.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish all released artifact signing and deployment details of the current upstream release.
Framework-delegated verification behavior depends on the packaged updater and release configuration.
